description: Remove members who have been inactive (no roles, not seen) for a number of days. SAFE BY DEFAULT: dry_run is true unless explicitly set to false, so call it first to preview the count, then re-call with dry_run:false to actually remove them. Removal is irreversible (members must rejoin). Requires the Kick Members permission.

dry_run.description: If true (default), only returns the count that would be pruned without removing anyone. Set false to actually prune.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the server audit log.

roles.description: Optional role IDs (snowflakes) to include; by default only members with no roles are counted.

name: discord_prune_members
